'''Chandra Conrad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She had information about the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, and came forward sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] as part of an investigation by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Horn had a trustworthy [[Agent/Legends|agent]] escort Conrad safely back to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CommonerZabrakFemTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Chandra Conrad]]
Chandra Conrad was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
